title: Clínica Veterinária de Cascais – Dr. Marques Vieira
subtitle: Vet clinic one-pager on the real identity
description: Bold, logo-driven one-pager for a Cascais vet clinic, in Portuguese and English. The emblem's cyan sky, triple ring and magenta/yellow animals shape the layout, with dog and cat panels, age pickers with life stages and a four-step booking wizard with live time slots.
conceptNote: Unofficial concept for a real business, using its existing logo. Not affiliated.
